mapper.select: SELECT sys22_mail_id AS mail_id , sys22_mail_address AS mail_address , to_decrypts(sys22_mail_passwd) AS mail_dec_password , sys22_note AS note FROM sys22_mail WHERE sys22_mail_id = #{mailId} AND sys22_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys22_mail (sys22_mail_id, sys22_company_id, sys22_mail_address, sys22_mail_passwd, sys22_note) VALUES (#{id}, #{companyId}, #{mailAddress}, #{password}, #{note})
